verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party LocalAI SDK. Developers are told to use third-party OpenAI or Anthropic-compatible clients pointed at the server. The Swagger spec is only a building block from which an SDK could be generated. These are adjacent compatibility and spec features, not official SDKs shipped by LocalAI, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
